title: Listen to the 'Verity Front Row' with Anne Hathaway & Josh Hartnett
summary: The full interview premieres on SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2) starting Friday, October 2 at 8am ET.
body_markdown:
The stars and director of the new thriller *Verity* — actors[Anne Hathaway](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/anne-hathaway) ,[Josh Hartnett](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/josh-hartnett) , and director Michael Showalter — joined[The Morning Mash Up ‘s Ryan and Nicole](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/morning-mash-up) on[SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-hits-1) for an exclusive[Front Row](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/town-hall) event.


[Verity Front Row Exclusive interview on Hits 1 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-SiriusXMHits1)


During the *Front Row* , Anne Hathaway reflected on preparing for her latest roles and her starstruck encounter with Dolly Parton and Tom Cruise, Josh Hartnett recalled his terrible food poisoning during filming, and the cast reacted to co-star Dakota Johnson’s cameo in[Taylor Swift’s new “Patient Zero” music video](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/matthew-stafford-taylor-swift-patient-zero) .


- **Related:[Watch The Odyssey Cast Event With Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/the-odyssey-cast-event-radio-andy)**


Listen to the full interview on SiriusXM Hits 1 on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-SiriusXMHits1) starting Friday, October 2 at 8am ET.


In the meantime, watch an exclusive clip from the *Verity Front Row* above.
